text: 南向资金今日净卖出13.98亿元。港股通（沪）方面，盈富基金、腾讯控股分别获净卖出20.31亿港元、0.69亿港元；中芯国际净买入额居首，金额为3.09亿港元；港股通（深）方面，腾讯控股、中国海洋石油分别获净卖出7.75亿港元、6.17亿港元；中芯国际净买入额居首，金额为8.43亿港元。
text_en: Southbound capital recorded a net sell of HK$1.398 billion today. On the Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect, Tracker Fund and Tencent Holdings saw net sells of HK$2.031 billion and HK$69 million respectively; SMIC led net buys with HK$309 million. On the Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect, Tencent Holdings and CNOOC saw net sells of HK$775 million and HK$617 million respectively; SMIC led net buys with HK$843 million.
